references.text: The Levitical clans are mentioned, including the clan of Merari as referred to in Joshua 21:34
The sons of Merari received twelve cities from the tribes of Zebulun, Reuben, and Gad, which begins the distribution described in verse 34
Summary of the cities given to the clans of Merari, a total of twelve cities
Parallel text describing the same cities given to the clans of Merari from the tribe of Zebulun
The clans of Merari and their responsibilities in Levitical service are described here
Jokneam is mentioned as a city within the inheritance of Zebulun, the same city that was given to the Levites
